title: Karatu: Coffee Farms Near the Ngorongoro Gate
excerpt: Karatu, near the Ngorongoro gate, is surrounded by coffee farms and green hills. A good base for the crater.
body:
## Location

Karatu is a small town on the road between Lake Manyara and the Ngorongoro gate, at about 1,500 m.

## Why stay here

- Close to the crater, but warmer than the rim.
- Coffee farms and lodges with gardens.
- Often more affordable than the rim.

## What to do

- Coffee farm tours.
- Walks in the hills.
- Visits to a local market.

## Crater days

From Karatu, it takes about 30 to 45 minutes to the gate and more to the crater floor. Start early.

See [the Ngorongoro Crater](/blog/ngorongoro-crater-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
